The denied lazy assignment selects the exact CodexLocalAccessSplash ESM export.
The denied component supplies contact-admin copy and a fixed informational URL.
The complete shared splash renders an anchor and invokes the imported browser bridge with the event and URL.
The selected routed consumer defines no logout, account-switch, purchase or access-request control.
The result-page goal differs from selected existing quota, account display and logout goals.
